channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.description: China's auto sales experienced a decline of 27% during the traditional peak season, prompting automakers to increase exports by 64%. This shift indicates a struggle in the domestic market despite historically strong sales periods. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
